bagPolicy.summary: MGM Grand Garden Arena does not publish one universal bag rule for every event. Review the official event information before arrival because size and type restrictions may vary.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.note: Parking availability, access routes, and pricing at MGM Grand Garden Arena can vary by event. Review the linked official information and reserve in advance when that option is offered.

rideshare.note: MGM Grand Garden Arena does not publish a permanent rideshare location for every event. Follow event-day traffic signs and confirm the active pickup point in your rideshare app.

concessions.note: Food and beverage availability at MGM Grand Garden Arena varies by event and operating setup. Review the linked official guest information before arrival.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: If you are holding non-accessible seating and require accessible seating sections, please contact us to make arrangements for accessible seating as far in advance of the event as possible. If you are holding seating in an accessible section and do not require the features of this type of seating, please contact the arena Box Office to exchange your seating into a non-accessible section based on availability.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in MGM Grand Garden Arena's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Current official guidance does not publish one universal will-call schedule for every event at MGM Grand Garden Arena. Use the delivery instructions in the official ticket order and confirm event-day box-office details before traveling to the venue.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at MGM Grand Garden Arena. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
